summary: Dynagas LNG Partners LP filed a Form 6-K on August 13, 2026, announcing a quarterly cash distribution of $0.050 per common unit for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The distribution is payable on August 28, 2026, to holders of record as of August 24, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. The filing includes no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor. There is no M&A activity, restructuring, or strategic event. The distribution reflects ordinary capital return to unitholders. What to watch: future distributions and LNG market conditions, but no special-situation angle.
